newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse closes higher under bullish mood.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse closes higher under bullish mood.

text.p: Bucharest bourse closing prices, volumes and turnover were higher on Friday under a strong buying interest extended from the previous session.
Seventeen companies had stronger closing prices, eight fell and seven remained flat. Nine companies had no trade and two were suspended.
"Foreign investors are eager to buy bourse heavyweights and that put upward pressure on them," one trader said.
Operators forecast a rally over the next week with investors putting pressure mainly on first-tier listings.
Volumes rose to 2.7 million shares from 2.4 million and turnover was around one billion lei higher at 11 billion.

Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, all based on average prices and market capitalisation, touched new year-highs, rising by 3.1, 3.02 and 3.1 respectively from the previous session.
The first tier's seven listings accounted for around 77 percent of turnover. Five saw higher prices at the close, one inched down and one was suspended pending announcements.
Fertiliser maker Azomures gained 50 lei to end at 3,850 and Oltchim chemical plant closed 50 lei firmer at 3,750. Pharmaceuticals company Terapia inched up 300 lei and closed at 7,300.
Another fertiliser maker, Sofert, went up 2,000 lei to a 33,000 lei close and Antibiotice pharmaceuticals had a 100 lei firmer close at 7,300.
On the second tier, Policolor dye maker was in the lime light, with 1.1 billion lei in turnover. It closed 150 lei higher at 6,350.
